entry.title: Argevox Gerät 1.0.1 (beta)
entry.summary: Packaging and metadata maintenance release for Argevox Gerät by Argerax. - Rebuilt ARMv7 and AArch64 ZIPs using current OpenMPC tools at `93804291aac2623a62cb2baacf8125c7270fe4e7`, with matching LF-only installation and uninstallation templates. - Corrected the existing hardware-test version to numeric `1.0.0`, matching the manifest of the engine tested by the author. - Recorded the author’s project CPU report: approximately 34% active versus 20% bypassed with Mini D, a difference of 14 percenta

entry.title: Argevox Gerät 1.0.0 (beta)
entry.summary: New 20-band engine inspired by the functional architecture of the Sennheiser VSM-201, with clearer spectral articulation, automatic tonal/noise excitation, formant shifting and dark-voice presets. Beta 2 consolidates the interface into five pages and keeps all twenty synthesis bands together. ## Manuals / Manuales / Handbücher - [English](https://github.com/ymn27nhnwd-hue/argevox-geraet/blob/v1.0.0-beta.2/docs/manual-en.md) - [Español](https://github.com/ymn27nhnwd-hue/argevox-geraet/blob/v1.0.0

entry.title: Argevox Gerät 0.2.1 (beta)
entry.summary: Vocoder de 20 bandas de Argerax para MPC standalone. Incluye umbral de voz, de-esser y faders táctiles por banda. **Probado por el autor:** v0.2.1 en MPC One+ con MPC OS 3.10.1, instalado manualmente. - `argevox-ger-t-0.2.1-mpc.zip`: instalación manual en `VST2 Plugins`, MPC OS 3.10.1 o posterior. - `*-mpc-armv7.zip` y `*-mpc-aarch64.zip`: paquetes de OpenMPC validados en local. La instalación desde el Plugin Manager, MPC OS 3.9.1 y el hardware Gen2 quedan por probar. [Manual de usuario](https:/
